title: World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2027, Davos (Jan 18-22) — the sixth January meeting in a row to open on the MLK closure
source: NEWS: davos.ch/en/experience/events/world-economic-forum-annual-meeting-2027, RE-FETCHED direct at HTTP 200 (241,201 bytes) on 2026-09-06 by this event's own initial research, independently of the proposal that first read it. "organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"World Economic Forum","url":"https://www.weforum.org"} ... "location":{"@type":"Place","name":"Kongresszentrum Davos"} ... NOT PRIMARY, and the reason is recorded rather than worked around: weforum.org is HTTP 403 to this runner on THREE URLs tried with a browser User-Agent -- /meetings/ (382 bytes), /events/world-economic-forum-annual-meeting-2027/ (445 bytes) and /press/ (379 bytes) -- so the WEF's own listing was not read, and unlike the nyse.com 403 that a sibling ledger resolved as a User-Agent artifact on the same day, THIS 403 reproduces under a browser User-Agent. Prefix is therefore NEWS: and status estimate. PROMOTION CRITERION: any weforum.org page listing the Annual Meeting 2027 dates, read at HTTP 200. notes: CANONICAL file written 2026-09-06 by this event's initial research after reading the single proposal, proposals/wef-davos-annual-meeting-2027-01-18.from-mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. The proposal's date and its blocked-source record both survive re-fetching; its FRAMING does not, and the correction is the reason this entry stays low impact. Measured this session over the 30 Annual Meetings dated 1995-2026 (dates: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Economic_Forum, HTTP 200; prices: cdn.cboe.com SPX_History.csv + VIX_History.csv, HTTP 200): (1) OPENING ON MLK IS THE CURRENT NORM, NOT A COLLISION -- every in-person January Annual Meeting since 2020 has started on the third Monday of January, i.e. ON the US market closure (2020, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026; 2021 was cancelled and 2022 moved to May), versus 0 of the 25 meetings 1995-2019. 2027-01-18 would be the sixth such year and the fifth in a row. (2) NO TAPE SIGNATURE -- the S&P 500's return over each meeting window sits at percentile 0.501 of same-length January windows (n=30, t=0.02 against a uniform 0.500); VIX change over the window averages +0.36 pts, t=0.94. (3) THE REOPEN GAP IS NOT BIGGER -- the first US session after an MLK closure that opened a Davos meeting moved |0.76%| on average (n=5) against |0.87%| for all post-MLK sessions 1998-2026 and |0.80%| for all January sessions; the 'Davos day-1 headlines arrive as a batch' story predicts the opposite sign of what the tape shows. (4) The Fed IS silent across all five 2027 Davos days -- the January FOMC blackout runs 2027-01-16 -> 2027-01-28 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16, estimate) and the decision (fomc-2027-01-27, estimate) lands the session after Davos closes -- but that is the THIRD CONSECUTIVE YEAR the meeting falls wholly inside the January blackout (2025, 2026, 2027), not a new configuration. WHY IMPACT IS LOW AND STAYS LOW: Davos is an agenda, not a print -- no consensus number, no scheduled release time, no surprise to measure -- and a re-run grep of trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md for davos|world economic forum|summit|conference returns zero hits in both. Its standing research value is the ATTRIBUTION TRAP on Tuesday 2027-01-19, which already has a three-day-weekend, post-expiration-unpin and Fed-silence explanation before it has a Davos one.
